rules.peaks: OpenStreetMap peaks and volcanoes (natural=peak/volcano) inside Vietnam that have a name and a height (ele) of at least 1,500 m, plus lower named peaks that carry a Wikidata link (notable mountains such as Bà Đen or Ba Vì). Heights are as mapped (metres above sea level), which can differ by a few metres from official surveys. A name mapped twice within 2 km is kept once (the higher).
rules.passes: OpenStreetMap mountain passes: nodes tagged mountain_pass=yes or natural=saddle, named by their own name or else by the road they lie on when that road is named Đèo …; plus roads named Đèo … that have no such node, placed at the middle of the mapped road (the road over the pass, not necessarily its summit). Only Vietnamese names (Đèo …, Dốc …, or a name:vi). Height (ele) where mapped.
rules.lakes: OpenStreetMap named lakes, reservoirs and lagoons (natural=water with water=lake/reservoir/lagoon, or landuse=reservoir) whose mapped outline covers at least 1 km² (outer rings minus inner rings). Capacity (volume) where OpenStreetMap tags it.
rules.dams: OpenStreetMap dams (waterway=dam) named Đập … or Thủy điện … (sluice gates, Cống …, are left out). Dams of the same core name within 5 km are one. A dam is matched to an OpenStreetMap hydropower plant (power=plant, plant:source=hydro) with the same core name within 10 km, which gives its installed capacity (plant:output:electricity); hydropower plants of 50 MW or more with no mapped dam are listed too, at the plant.
rules.gates: OpenStreetMap border controls (barrier=border_control) inside Vietnam whose Vietnamese name contains Cửa khẩu, shown from those words on ("Trạm Kiểm soát Liên hợp Cửa khẩu Tây Trang" → Cửa khẩu Tây Trang; Chinese characters and a trailing address dropped). The class (international, main or secondary gate) is the one in the mapped name (Cửa khẩu quốc tế …, Cửa khẩu chính …, Cửa khẩu phụ …); it is left blank when the name does not say. Two crossings of the same name (with or without “quốc tế”) within 5 km are one. Not an official register: some gates are unmapped or unnamed.
rules.parks: OpenStreetMap industrial land (landuse=industrial) named Khu công nghiệp …, KCN … or … Industrial Park/Zone, whose mapped outline covers at least 20 ha. Outlines of one park mapped as several parts are summed by name. Not the official list of the Ministry of Planning: unmapped parks are missing.
rules.crafts: OpenStreetMap features named as craft villages (Làng nghề …, or Làng + a craft: gốm, lụa, đúc, mộc, rèn, tranh, hương, nón, chiếu, dệt, thêu, đá, mây, gỗ, sơn mài, bạc, đồng, giấy, khảm, chạm, nhang, bánh, bún, miến, nước mắm, gạch, trống, đan). Not the official register of recognised craft villages; coverage is patchy.
rules.battles: Wikidata battles (instances of a subclass of battle, Q178561) that have their own coordinate on Vietnam's land (or within 2 hexes of it) and articles in at least 4 Wikipedia languages (a notability threshold). Operation Babylift (an evacuation flight that Wikidata classes as a battle) is left out. Year from the item's point in time or start time.
rules.festivals: The rows of the table "Danh sách một số lễ hội" of the Vietnamese Wikipedia article Lễ hội Việt Nam that give a start day (lunar calendar, as the table states) and a place in one province, placed at the coordinates of the article linked in the festival cell (GeoData, else its Wikidata item) only when that point lies within 3 km of the province the table names; else at the coordinates of the most specific place linked in the place cell (a district, a mountain; position marked approximate), with the same check. Nationwide festivals (Tết Trung thu …) have no single place and are left out.
